items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 1.4% in 1985 to 1.8% in 2025 across 12 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).
6 of 12 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life; 4 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 12 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 3 of 3 high-need ones have none.
